item.title: Missing national speed limit signs on approach to roundabout., 24th July
item.description:
When approaching the C and G roundabout from Barnbett Way or Conirnium Avenue, a national speed limit sign indicates that the speed limit on the roundabout is 70mpg (for ordinary cars). However, when approaching from Zoons COurt or Elmbridge Court, there is no national speed limit sign at the point where a system of street lights commences. This results in a a default speed limit of 30mph. Therefore due to inconsistent signage, the speed limit on the "C and G" roundabout is either 30mpg or 70mph depending on which way you approach it. This cannot be correct.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): C&G Roundabout, Hucclecote, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet
